title: 第25章 擂台战金身逞威第26章 绝美清影真身现
content_zh:
“抱歉，谢师兄久等了。”
林玄不急不慢上了擂台。
谢清影的目光打量着林玄，察觉到他身上依旧有着一丝刚刚突破的痕迹，微微眯着眼说道：
“你来晚了应该是是修炼耽搁的吧，不得不说，林玄师弟，你是我见过毅力最强，修炼最刻苦之人！若是再过一年半载兴许我不会是你的对手。”
“但是现在......”
还没说完，林玄便淡声说道：
“现在也是。”
此话一出，谢清影俊逸无比的脸顿时冷了下来。
“狂妄的家伙！你这人什么都好！就是说话太让人气愤！”
下一刻，谢清影直接出手，折扇一拍，身法顿时如同鬼魅一般，朝着林玄攻击而去。
“刷！！”
那折扇居然带着无比锋利的刀刃，见此一幕。林玄眸眼微凝，瞬间后退几步，拉开距离。
谢清影相继而来，出手快如雷电！
但林玄的速度也不逞多让，一劫剑体成型之后，让他全身体质蜕变，身法也快了许多倍。
很快，俩人再次拉开距离，各站一方，对峙而立。
“林玄师弟，你只会躲吗？”
谢清影眉头微皱询问。
“谢师兄，我不想把时间浪费在这些无聊的比试上面，相信你也是吧？不如我们一招定胜负如何？”
林玄淡声说道，他还有太多的境界要提升，这样的比武只能提升一些战斗经验罢了，没什么其他益处。
这话一说出，现场顿时喧嚣了起来。

很多长老都在议论，特别是执法长老闻松。
“好狂妄的小子！此乃副门主定下的擂台武斗，他居然敢如此轻视！”
闻松长老冷哼说着，声音故意大了好几分，生怕位于上面的副门主厉秋雨没听到。
厉秋雨戴着面纱如同女皇坐于上方，此时听到林玄的话以及诸多长老的讨论，也是俏眉微皱，不知道林玄何来的底气说出这样的话。
而谢清影作为与林玄对战之人，此时更是感觉到了莫大的气愤，这话把她置于何地！？
“可以！”
谢清影脸色彻底变冷，冷声说着，准备轰出自己最强一击，不打算留手！
“谢师兄，请！”
林玄点头，站于原地，准备强接谢清影一招。
“这......他难道是想找死吗？居然敢硬接大师兄一招！？大师兄可是有着天武境强者的实力啊！”
“天武境强者的全力一击，就算是元武巅峰都得半死，何况他才刚进入元武境不久，太狂妄了！”
“天作孽犹可违，自作孽不可活！”
众人见此一幕，纷纷议论起来，基本上都是觉得林玄在找死，冷嘲热讽。
而坐于长老席的祝红菱跟祝天虹都是脸露担心之色，在这整个无极门，也只有他们才担心林玄的安危。
其他人基本上都是站在谢清影这一边的。
“这一招，我只出过一次，便是一招切下四阶妖兽风暴魔狼的头颅！”
谢清影折扇一开，还未出手。
content_en:
"Sorry, thank you for waiting for a long time, senior brother."
Lin Xuan took his time and entered the ring.
Xie Qingying looked at Lin Xuan with his eyes and noticed that he still had traces of a recent breakthrough. He squinted slightly and said:
"You are late because you are delayed in your cultivation. I have to say, Junior Brother Lin Xuan, you are the person with the strongest perseverance and the hardest training I have ever seen! If it takes another year and a half, I may not be your opponent."
"But now..."
Before he finished speaking, Lin Xuan said quietly:
"Even now."
As soon as these words came out, Xie Qingying's extremely handsome face suddenly turned cold.
"Arrogant guy! You are good at everything! It's just your words that make people infuriating!"
The next moment, Xie Qingying took action directly, slapping her folding fan, and her movement was like a ghost, attacking Lin Xuan.
"Brush!!"
The folding fan actually had an extremely sharp blade when he saw this scene. Lin Xuan's eyes narrowed slightly, and he immediately took a few steps back to distance himself.
Xie Qingying came one after another, and his attacks were as fast as lightning!
But Lin Xuan's speed was not to be outdone. After the Yi Jie Sword Body was formed, his whole body changed and his movement became many times faster.
Soon, the two people distanced themselves again, each standing on one side, facing each other.
"Junior brother Lin Xuan, can you only hide?"
Xie Qingying asked with a slight frown.
"Thank you, senior brother, I don't want to waste time on these boring competitions, I believe you do too, right? How about we decide the outcome with one move?"
Lin Xuan said softly that he still had too much to improve. This kind of competition can only improve some combat experience and has no other benefits.
As soon as these words were said, the scene suddenly became noisy.
Many elders are talking about it, especially law enforcement elder Wen Song.
"What an arrogant boy! This is an arena fight set by the deputy sect master, and he actually dares to look down upon it like this!"
Elder Wen Song snorted coldly, his voice deliberately louder, for fear that Li Qiuyu, the deputy sect leader above, wouldn't hear him.
Li Qiuyu wore a veil and was sitting above her like a queen. When she heard Lin Xuan's words and the discussions of many elders, she also frowned slightly. She didn't know where Lin Xuan had the confidence to say such words.
As the person who was fighting against Lin Xuan, Xie Qingying felt even more angry at this moment. Where did this put her! ?
"Okay!"
Xie Qingying's face turned completely cold, and she said in a cold voice, preparing to launch her strongest blow and not holding back!
"Thank you, senior brother, please!"
Lin Xuan nodded and stood there, ready to take Xie Qingying's move.
"This...is he looking for death? How dare he take a move from the senior brother!? The senior brother has the strength of a strong man in the Tianwu Realm!"
"A full-strength strike from a strong man in the Tianwu Realm would kill even the peak Yuanwu Realm, not to mention that he has just entered the Yuanwu Realm. He is so arrogant!"
"If you do evil by God, you can still violate it, but if you do evil by yourself, you can't live!"
When everyone saw this scene, they started talking one after another. Basically, they all felt that Lin Xuan was seeking death and made sarcastic remarks.
Zhu Hongling and Zhu Tianhong, who were sitting at the elders' table, both had worried expressions on their faces. In the entire Wuji Sect, they were the only ones worried about Lin Xuan's safety.
The others are basically on Xie Qingying's side.
"I have only used this move once, which was to cut off the head of the fourth-level monster Storm Wolf with one move!"
Xie Qingying opened the folding fan but had not yet taken action.
